$comment: The .NET coverage contract. Floors are a no-regression ratchet, measured 2026-11-04 with
the CI-pinned SDK 10.0.402, merged from the five test projects by scripts/coverage-report.sh
(the pinned codecov-report tool), the same reporter the gate job uses. Three further full
runs after the PR #53 review corrections agreed to within 0.02 points.
Coverage used to oscillate by 0.41 points (13 files called Random.Shared directly); after
the IRandomSource injection series and the seeded tests, four consecutive full runs spanned
at most 0.02 points on any assembly, so the headroom below is measured rather than hoped for.
A floor is trunc(lowest observed run) minus 1 point, not trunc(measured): a floor with sub-1
point headroom fails intermittently. Never lower a floor. Raise it in the PR that lifts the
measured value 3+ points above it (scripts/check-dotnet-coverage.mjs --suggest names them).
Target is 90% line everywhere; branch coverage carries no separate target and is gated only
